title: Kong key-auth converted without credential inclusion fails closed
claims: without explicit credential inclusion the synthetic key is absent from every output file and stream
the protected route never forwards a request, even one presenting the original key
the report flags that credentials were withheld and need re-provisioning
not_claimed: How operators re-provision keys after migration (outside the converter)
source_semantics: Kong would admit the original key; refusing it here is the migration policy (credentials withheld by default), so the valid-key probe is ferrum_only and is never replayed against Kong.
